spec.v: BTT Octopus V1.1, STM32F446, USB-to-CAN bridge
Mellow FLY-SB2040 V2 on CAN (Katapult + Klipper v0.13.0)
CoreXY, 0.9° A/B motors, TMC2209, 9000 mm/s² max
X mzv 68.2 Hz · Y ei 69.4 Hz
SSR on HE1, max_power 0.6, adaptive mesh
GIT_BACKUP → GitHub (deploy key) · restore points + SD image on the Mac

mods.part: Aluminum gantry and A/B motor mounts (3DPrintingMods VoronTrident-AluminumG)
mods.note: Replaces the printed XY gantry: A/B motor mounts, tensioners, front idlers, XY joints. 6 mm belt version. The metal motor mounts have no built-in cable channel, so wiring has to be routed tight to the motors, clear of the belts.

mods.part: Clockwork 2 large gear adapter (Bondtech LGX Lite gears)
mods.note: Runs the CW2 on Bondtech LGX Lite large gears, 44:10 + 37:17 (bondtech.se). Nominal rotation_distance 5.7; calibrated 5.56 by measuring extruded filament. Motor run_current 0.6 A (Bondtech range 0.45-0.60 A).
CNC version of Badnoob's Voron Tap: MGN7H rail, magnetic limit assembly, 65 g. OMRON EE-SX4320 optical sensor rated 5-24 V. Replaces the X carriage (CW2-style mount).

log.title: Fluidd theme: cyberpunk layer
log.body: Added on top of the TRIDENT theme: neon cyan/magenta card frames with HUD corner brackets, a faint neon grid, cyan card titles, magenta table headers, and a chromatic, briefly glitching TRIDENT title. Mocked up in a browser tab first, then applied. Also in the bookmarklet stylesheet.

log.title: Fixed probing timeouts over CAN
log.body: Two prints cancelled during PRINT_START with "Communication timeout during homing" (Tap on the Mellow, Z motors on the Octopus). CAN bus was clean; the Pi 3 had one core pinned by Obico's live-video transcode. Turned off Obico live video (snapshots and failure detection still on), removed the dead nozzle camera from crowsnest, raised can0 txqueuelen to 1024.

log.title: First test print on the CAN toolhead
log.body: Voron Design Cube, ABS, 41 min, completed. Klipper stayed ready throughout; CAN 0 errors, 0 drops; no driver or timing warnings. Mellow MCU peaked at 56 °C. Next: 9x9 mm heatsink on the extruder driver.

log.title: Extruder fault fixed: coil pairs re-pinned
log.body: Root cause of the TMC short-to-supply / open-load faults: the extruder plug had its coil pairs on pins 1-3 and 2-4. Swapping the middle two wires put each coil on adjacent pins as the Mellow header expects. Motor coils measured about 2 Ω per pair. Also found and re-crimped the Tap signal wire, which had broken at the terminal and caused a Z homing crash; Z tilt corrected 3.03 mm back to 0.004 mm.

log.title: Extruder driver fault on first extrusion
log.body: TMC2209 on the Mellow reported short-to-supply and open load on both coils during a 100 mm test at 255 °C. Klipper shut down safely. Next: check the extruder motor plug and coil pairs.

log.title: Tap found on gpio28, inverted
log.body: Mellow's docs disagree on endstop numbering; a three-pin test showed the Tap on gpio28. Probe, fans, LEDs, heater (100 °C, ±0.3) and X/Y/Z homing all verified, CAN at 0 errors.

log.title: Toolhead moved to CAN (sb2040.cfg)
log.body: Extruder, hotend, fans, Tap, Stealthburner LEDs and ADXL now on the Mellow; cw2.cfg replaced. Hotend sensor is the ATC Semitec 104NT on TH0 (this board has no PT100 chip). Enclosure thermistor commented out, removed with the old harness.

log.title: Klipper v0.13.0 on the Mellow over CAN
log.body: Flashed through Katapult (16 KiB offset). Bus termination checked at 59.4 Ω with the Mellow 120R jumper fitted.

log.title: Katapult bootloader on the Mellow SB2040 V2
log.body: Flashed over USB with the XT30 unplugged (the board would not enter flash mode while on 24 V). Mellow settings: W25Q080, CAN gpio4/gpio5 at 1 Mbit, double-tap reset, status LED gpio24. Future firmware updates go over CAN.

log.title: Tailscale on the Pi
log.body: Remote SSH and Fluidd from anywhere without port forwarding. Installed from Tailscale's official Raspbian repo; Moonraker now trusts the Tailscale address range.

log.title: Fluidd theme: TRIDENT
log.body: Custom theme in .fluidd-theme/ (custom.css + wolf logo.svg) per the Fluidd docs, matching this site: CRT scanlines, JetBrains Mono, Akira-red title, brass card headers. Applies on top of any preset; delete the folder to go back to stock. Also available as a browser-only bookmarklet (fluidd-trident.css).

log.title: Toolhead build started
log.body:
Phase 1: converting the Stealthburner to CAN with the Mellow FLY SB2040 V2; hotend, extruder and Tap unchanged. Old harness removed, new twisted-pair CAN + 24 V cable run through the drag chains. The SB2209 was ruled out: it doesn't sit flush on the CW2 with the large-gear housing.
Phase 2 (later): A4T toolhead with an EBB36, Rapido hotend with PT100, filament sensor.

log.title: Test results saved: PID and mesh
log.body: Home, Z tilt, PID, pressure advance and bed mesh all passed. CAN bus clean through all tests: 0 errors, 0 drops.

log.title: macOS metadata file removed from the repo
log.body: ._* and .DS_Store now ignored.

log.title: PID_EXTRUDER / PID_BED buttons restored
log.body: Each has a TARGET field in Fluidd and saves the result.

log.title: Switched to the official fluidd-config
log.body: fluidd.cfg now links to ~/fluidd-config/client.cfg and updates through Moonraker. CANCEL_PRINT now retracts, parks and clears the mesh.

log.title: IggyTheWolf logo header in printer.cfg
log.body: Regenerated from the original image at the correct character aspect.

log.title: printer.cfg restyled
log.body: Boxed section headers, dead commented options and the unused chamber thermistor removed, adxl.cfg include moved to the top. Parsed settings compared before and after: identical apart from the intended changes.

log.title: macros.cfg tidied
log.body: Dead code and one-line wrappers removed, CASELIGHT VALUE= replaces LEDON/LEDOFF, PURGE_FILAMENT and PA_CAL cleaned up, [bed_mesh] moved to printer.cfg.

log.title: KAMP replaced by Klipper's built-in adaptive mesh
log.body: BED_MESH_CALIBRATE ADAPTIVE=1 with adaptive_margin 0. KAMP files, includes and the repo on the Pi removed.

log.title: PRINT_START: Tap probe temp named PROBE_TEMP
nozzle_scrub.cfg cut from 229 to 27 lines
log.body: Same wipe: X186 ↔ X226 at Y310, 8 passes.

log.title: PID macros fixed
log.body: SAVE_CONFIG shared a line with TURN_OFF_HEATERS and never ran, and the TARGET_TEMP parameter was ignored.

log.title: PA_CAL: deprecated ACCEL_TO_DECEL replaced
log.body: Now MINIMUM_CRUISE_RATIO=0.5.

log.title: [mcu] moved from serial to canbus_uuid 844419e24ade
log.body: Old serial and restart_method lines kept as comments for rollback.

log.title: can0 network interface on the Pi
log.body: /etc/network/interfaces.d/can0: 1 Mbit, txqueuelen 128, comes up on boot. Octopus shows as a gs_usb CAN adapter, state ERROR-ACTIVE.

log.title: Octopus flashed as USB-to-CAN bridge
log.body: STM32F446, 12 MHz, 32 KiB bootloader, USB on PA11/PA12, CAN on PD0/PD1 at 1 Mbit. The first build had CAN on PB8/PB9 and was caught before flashing. Needed a full power cycle to take the new firmware.

log.title: Post-update restore point
log.body: Taken after a 14 minute test print. Includes both Octopus firmware builds.

log.title: moonraker.conf: update channel set to stable
Octopus reflashed v0.10.0 → v0.13.0 (USB)
log.body: Board had been running 2022 firmware. Flashed firmware.bin from a microSD card; that card now stays in the Octopus so later flashes can be done remotely.

log.title: Klipper stack updated
log.body:
Klipper v0.12.0-249 → v0.13.0
Moonraker v0.8.0 → v0.11.0 (database migrated, stats intact)
Fluidd 1.30.0 → 1.37.6
Obico 2.0.1 → 2.2.3
crowsnest 4.1.9 → 4.2.0
Config checked against every v0.13 breaking change: no edits needed.

log.title: System packages upgraded
log.body: 201 apt packages upgraded on Raspbian 11 bullseye. No kernel change, no reboot needed. Moonraker update channel switched from dev to stable.

log.title: Full SD card image
log.body: 32 GB card imaged to voron-sd-2026-09-29.img.gz (3.3 GB). gzip test passed and the uncompressed size matches the card byte for byte. Restore steps in RESTORE.md.

log.title: Rollback firmware built for the Octopus
log.body: USB-mode firmware for Klipper v0.12.0-249 saved in ~/Voron-Backups/firmware. Found the Pi's saved build settings were for an SB2209 RP2040 on CAN; kept as sb2209-rp2040-can.config.

log.title: GitHub config backup rebuilt
log.body: The old repo on the Pi was gone and .autocommit.sh still pointed at ~/klipper_config. New SSH deploy key limited to this repo, rewritten backup script that refuses database files and the Obico token, new .gitignore. Existing GitHub history kept.

log.title: First restore point pulled to the Mac
log.body: Config folder (symlinks resolved), Moonraker database snapshot, Octopus firmware settings and KIAUH settings, saved to the Mac outside Dropbox. Database snapshot checked and intact.
